derivation: Four-pad Kelvin split of Stackpole's two lands (DESIGN-SPEC 4.1: sense taps at the inner pad edges, net-tie footprint). Each land (x +-0.70..+-1.95, y +-0.90) is cut into a force pad (pad 1 left, 4 right) and a 0.40 x 0.40 sense pad (pad 2 left, 3 right) in the land's inner corner on the +y side (x +-0.70..+-1.10, y +0.50..+0.90), separated from the force copper by a 0.10 mm gap (force pad = land minus x +-0.70..+-1.20, y +0.40..+0.90). All copper stays inside the datasheet land, nothing in the gap under the element; the sense trace leaves the sense pad on the +y edge, 0.25 mm from the force copper. Both pads of one end sit under the same terminal (terminal inner edge at 0.60-1.00 from the centre), the solder joint ties them. Net-tie pad groups 1,2 and 3,4 exempt the 0.10 gap from clearance. Pad numbers = Device:R_Shunt (1/4 current, 2/3 sense). Dense: budget_v6 '1206' envelope 3.9 x 1.8 vs Stackpole land 4.8 x 1.8: outer pad length b cut 1.70 -> 1.25 (gap a 1.40 and height c 1.80 kept); toe beyond the part end 0.35 nominal / 0.25 at L max (>= IPC-7351B chip least-density toe 0.15); Stackpole's long pads spread the 2 W rating, the board dissipates 0.2-0.31 W (spec 4.1) into solid +BATT_IN/+BATT pours
